The physics of the grip are questionable. The fingers seem to merge slightly with the metal post rather than compressing against it realistically. The pressure points lack realistic skin deformation (whitening of knuckles).

The background posts exhibit inconsistent depth-of-field blur. Some parts of the same post appear sharper than others despite being at similar depths, suggesting minor geometric warping or AI-generated bokeh inconsistencies.
